description: A subscription record published by a user in their own repo to request evaluations from a specific evaluator service. The evaluator detects subscriptions via Jetstream and processes matching records. Deleting this record unsubscribes.

main.description: User subscription to an evaluator service. Published by the user (not the evaluator) to declare they want evaluations.

collections.description: Which of the user's record collections should be evaluated (NSIDs). Must be a subset of the evaluator's subjectCollections. If omitted, all supported collections are evaluated.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when this subscription was created.

evaluationTypes.description: Which evaluation types the user wants. If omitted, all types the evaluator supports are applied.

evaluator.description: DID of the evaluator service to subscribe to.
